name: Brine Leviathan

Traits.name: Earth Glide
Traits.text: The brine leviathan can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the brine leviathan doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the brine leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The brine leviathan makes three Tail attacks.

Actions.name: Tail
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. 17 (2d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Cold damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Shadow Veil
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the brine leviathan takes the Hide action.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the brine leviathan can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Lagoon Lunge
Legendary Actions.text: The brine leviathan moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Tail attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Slip into Shadow
Legendary Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the brine leviathan takes the Hide action. The brine leviathan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.name: Frozen Terror
Legendary Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 22, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A leviathan sealed beneath a frozen lake in ages past, grown vast and sluggish on the lake's cold, it waits with the patience of a glacier for any warm thing to walk across its surface.
